scope_boundary: This catalog records public surfaces and their present maturity. A listed route is not evidence that the full 24 October launch outcome for its pillar is complete.

pillars.name: IGRM Core
pillars.current_boundary: Daily and seven-day press-salience measurement, receipts, vintages and operational evidence are live; salience is not risk or a forecast.

pillars.name: IGRM Atlas
pillars.current_boundary: Maps, event geography, sector exposure and episode navigation are public. The Global Event and Episode Ledger exposes a value-free rights-gate status only; no ledger counts or episodes are released. India Exposure DNA and the bounded Shock Compiler have signed synthetic conformance foundations, while authorized source-event identity, production canonical events and declared real firm-port-commodity-state universes remain October objectives.

pillars.name: IGRM Evidence Engine
pillars.current_boundary: OGES 0.1, schemas, signed synthetic knowledge replay, semantically separated Sensor Fusion, provenance-oriented research tools and frozen machine interfaces are public; no production canonical-object release has yet been issued.

pillars.name: IGRM Research Copilot
pillars.current_boundary: A limited evidence interface and deterministic workbench are public; unrestricted grounded natural-language research over canonical releases is not yet live.

pillars.name: IGRM Observatory
pillars.current_boundary: Historical, event-study, market-comparison and analytical surfaces are public; full event dossiers, hypothesis ledgers and recovery monitoring remain October objectives.

pillars.name: IGRM Benchmark Lab
pillars.current_boundary: Validation batteries, comparison studies, negative findings and experimental forecast records are public; no universal superiority claim is licensed.

pillars.name: IGRM Institution
pillars.current_boundary: Methods, status, corrections and falsification surfaces are public; external governance, pilots, continuity and adoption must be earned and documented.

pillars.name: IGRM Distribution
pillars.current_boundary: Open pages, data, feeds, embeds, notes and citation tools are live; multilingual institutional packages and role-specific compiled outputs remain October objectives.

routes.label: Analysis

routes.label: Ask IGRM
routes.purpose: A deliberately bounded evidence-access prototype, not an unrestricted or authoritative chatbot.

routes.label: IGRM Atlas
routes.purpose: The integrated public hub for geography, detected episodes, sector salience, synthetic exposure fingerprints and bounded scenario compilation.

routes.label: Break this index
routes.purpose: Falsification questions, reproducible probes and the standard for publishing a serious failure.

routes.label: Codebook
routes.purpose: Definitions, fields, units, construction choices and known limitations.

routes.label: Corrections
routes.purpose: The dated public record of errors, withdrawals, restatements and methodological corrections.

routes.label: Data library
routes.purpose: Core downloadable files, caveats, citation instructions and the exhaustive API contract.

routes.label: Divergence register
routes.purpose: Permanent comparator disagreements with exact samples, receipts and claim limits.

routes.label: India Exposure DNA
routes.purpose: A signed synthetic two-vintage fingerprint that preserves direct exposure units, declared-universe coverage, freshness and explicit gaps without a scalar score.

routes.label: Embeddable charts
routes.purpose: A compact public chart surface for external sites, with each series and unit explicitly labelled.

routes.label: Episode dossiers
routes.purpose: A directory and detail view for detected episodes and their associated market-context cells.

routes.label: Outcomes explorer
routes.purpose: Historical episode-outcome cells and registered divergence evidence, labelled as association.

routes.label: Sector exposure
routes.purpose: A user-selected sector view over current channel readings, evidence and transparent computation.

routes.label: History Lab
routes.purpose: Registered baselines with their denominators, candidate structural breaks with the settings that move them, and deterministic analog retrieval over the frozen 1979-2019 archive.

routes.label: Historical proxy
routes.purpose: The 1979–2019 newspaper attention proxy and its explicit comparability boundary.

routes.label: Current measure
routes.purpose: The latest seven-day headline, channel decomposition, historical tape and research evidence.

routes.label: Global Event and Episode Ledger
routes.purpose: A value-free public count-unit and rights-gate surface. Candidate aggregate and detector values remain withheld until all required source decisions are human-signed; unique and canonical events remain separately unavailable.

routes.label: Maps
routes.purpose: India-partner and state-level press-recorded event geography, with explicit source and boundary limits.

routes.label: Methodology
routes.purpose: The complete construction, evaluation, limitations and versioned change record.

routes.label: Weekly notes
routes.purpose: Versioned public research notes derived from the instrument and its evidence.

routes.label: Explore IGRM
routes.purpose: The authoritative directory of every user-facing product and its present maturity boundary.

routes.label: Evidence receipts
routes.purpose: Latest-day query-matched evidence representatives, lane status, denominators and source composition.

routes.label: Knowledge replay
routes.purpose: A signed synthetic bitemporal replay demonstration that prevents later revisions from entering an earlier knowledge cutoff.

routes.label: Historical research note
routes.purpose: The focused research interpretation of the historical attention proxy.

routes.label: Sensor Fusion
routes.purpose: A signed synthetic eight-lane matrix that collates unlike evidence without numeric blending and names every missing lane.

routes.label: Bounded Shock Compiler
routes.purpose: A signed synthetic scenario compiler that preserves assumptions, exact exposure paths, original denominators, source freshness, bounded ranges and abstentions without forecasting.

routes.label: Open evidence standard
routes.purpose: The OGES 0.1 profile, conformance boundary, schemas and adversarial test vectors.

routes.label: Start here
routes.purpose: A bounded orientation to what the instrument measures, how to read it and what it cannot answer.

routes.label: System status
routes.purpose: Freshness and reliability for selected core publication lanes and sources.

routes.label: Evaluation record
routes.purpose: Episode detection, baselines, robustness, comparisons and disclosed unfavorable diagnostics.

routes.label: API byte verifier
routes.purpose: An on-demand same-origin byte-consistency check for the complete declared API manifest, optionally anchored by a separately obtained digest.

routes.label: Data viewer
routes.purpose: A bounded browser for every contract-listed JSON endpoint.

routes.label: Point-in-time vintages
routes.purpose: Reconstruct what the published series showed at earlier publication times without hindsight leakage.

routes.label: GPR comparison
routes.purpose: A registered, bounded comparison with AI-GPR India, including uncertainty and divergences.

routes.label: Research workbench
routes.purpose: Browser-side exact extracts with input hashes and a citation-bearing manifest.

routes.label: World State Matrix
routes.purpose: A complete 247-country/area by fourteen-domain coverage matrix that publishes real observations and every unavailable cell without a world risk score.
